added.name: Import and export
added.text: (Settings > Import and export): bookmarks straight from Chrome or Edge (last used profile, folders kept as groups), bookmarks from any browser's HTML export, passwords from Chrome's CSV export (encrypted with your passphrase on import); export bookmarks as HTML and passwords as Chrome-style CSV.

added.name: Full page
added.text: Link on every toolbar panel (OwlKick, Data saver, Secure DNS, site information).

sections.title: Added
items: **Import and export** (Settings > Import and export): bookmarks straight from Chrome or Edge (last used profile, folders kept as groups), bookmarks from any browser's HTML export, passwords from Chrome's CSV export (encrypted with your passphrase on import); export bookmarks as HTML and passwords as Chrome-style CSV.
**Full page** link on every toolbar panel (OwlKick, Data saver, Secure DNS, site information).

sections.title: Fixed
items: Site information shows who issued the certificate and until when; it showed only "verified by Windows".

sections.title: Changed
items: The Owl. mark sits at the start of the address bar row next to Back; Home sits next to Reload.
Every screenshot on the site and in the README is retaken with the new layout and the Owl. wordmark.
Releases are marked as pre-releases while Owl. is in the 0.x alpha.
